svg.title: Weight fingerprints and lineage
svg.desc: A deterministic 256-row block from the middle of each matrix is sketched from both sides with fixed, seeded orthonormal operators into a 64 by 64 sketch, and hashed with SHA-256 together with its dtype. Two models are compared view by view with sketch cosine and shared hashes. Lineage evidence is declared, detected or verified, and stays uncalibrated without an applicable calibrated null.
svg.text: SHA-256 of dtype and raw bytes
uncalibrated until an applicable calibrated null exists
